newsitem.title: ITALY: STET comments on Finsiel, Sirti, Italtel.
newsitem.headline: STET comments on Finsiel, Sirti, Italtel.

text.p: Italian state-controlled telecoms holding STET on Friday commented on the future for its units Finsiel, Sirti and Italtel when the group released 1996 results.
It said in a results statement that its data processing arm Finsiel would aim to develop synergies with STET's core telecoms business.

STET added that it would review its level of involvement in cable-making unit Sirti. STET has a 48.9 percent stake in Sirti and Italian newspapers have suggested a sale of the stake could be made by the summer.
On STET's telecoms systems maker Italtel, STET says it is looking to accelerate its integration with Siemens. The German group already has a 50 percent stake in Italtel.
